provenance: Values transcribed from the printed outputs of the original notebook execution (now notebooks/01_pretraining_walkthrough.ipynb, git 0c966c4). Nothing here was re-measured; fields that the notebook did not record are null.

data.packing_note: Remainder dropped once per 1,000-story map batch (fixed in the current pipeline).

tokenizer.normalization: NFKC + ASCII punctuation mapping + removal of all remaining non-ASCII characters

final_train_loss_note: Last logged training loss (Trainer log table). The notebook's printed 'Final training loss: 0.0001' is an artifact of resuming from a checkpoint at the end of training and is not a training loss.
validation_split: official TinyStories 'validation' split (21,989 stories after cleaning, 9,121 packed sequences)
validation_note: This split was also used for checkpoint selection (load_best_model_at_end). It is a development-validation result, not a held-out test result. In the current protocol this same split is the TEST split, so the legacy checkpoint cannot produce an untouched test number on it.
wall_clock_note: Not recorded. The printed 'Training finished in 0.4 minutes' measured only the final resumed call.
peak_vram_note: The notebook printed 4.49 GB peak allocated, measured in the final resumed session (at most one optimizer step plus evaluation at micro-batch 24). It is reported in README.md as an observation, not as a training benchmark.
checkpoint_note: model.safetensors printed as 107.00 MB (26,747,392 fp32 parameters = 106,989,568 bytes + header). The checkpoint itself is not in this repository.
known_issues: Loss discontinuity at step ~4,000 (training loss spikes to ~5.4, validation loss rises): the run is two phases, not one uninterrupted run. See README.md.
Validation split used for model selection is the official split now reserved as TEST.
Sampling in the notebook's generate() helper used top_k=50 in addition to top_p.

29.9% of the official validation stories (6,582 / 21,989) have an exact copy in the official train split (results/data_integrity_official_splits.json); the validation loss therefore partly measures training stories.
